newsitem.title: USA: Prime Bancorp converts to commercial bank.
newsitem.headline: Prime Bancorp converts to commercial bank.

text.p: Bank holding company Prime Bancorp Inc said Friday it plans convert to a commercial bank.

Prime, which holds $923 million in assets, will merge its two subsidiaries -- savings bank Prime Bank First and commercial bank Sterling Bank -- to form one commercial bank. The new entity will be called called Prime Bank and trade under the same ticker symbol.
Legislation passed by Congress made possible the conversion to a commercial bank, Prime said, adding it expected the merger to take place later this year.
Prime said it expected full commercial bank status to result in a better, more diversified balance sheet, lower costs, streamlined regulatory review and improved market perception.
